parent: Nippon Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. (NSG Group)
notes: NSG Glass North America Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary that built the Luckey/Troy Township float and TCO glass plant (announced Oct 2018, opened Nov 2020, 125-150 jobs) to supply First Solar. Parent NSG Group is Tokyo-based with 25,356 employees as of March 2024 (higher, around 27,000, in the 2019-2021 grant years); it acquired Ohio-rooted Pilkington North America in 2006.

parent: United States Steel Corp. and Kobe Steel Ltd. (50/50 joint venture)
notes: PRO-TEC is a 50/50 JV of U.S. Steel (Pittsburgh, PA) and Kobe Steel (Kobe, Japan) per U.S. Steel's SEC exhibit on the $400M Leipsic galvanizing line that started up in 2019; neither partner alone controls, so PA is the U.S. partner's HQ and Japan is the other half. Both parents have tens of thousands of employees (U.S. Steel about 22,000-28,000; Kobe Steel about 38,000); the JV itself reported 397 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 310 retained jobs.

County community improvement corporation (a nonprofit economic development corporation under Ohio law) that received a $4.2M JobsOhio site grant through the JobsOhio-Ohio Southeast Site Initiative/OSIP to build water, sewer and a road for the Winchester Industrial Park. Staffed by the county's economic development office, so headcount is a handful; no employee figure is published.

Canon Inc. (Tokyo, about 184,000 employees in 2021) bought 70% of QED on Oct 31, 2019 and consolidates it, covering the 2021 and 2022 grants; the 2018 grant predates the sale, when QED was founder-owned with about 175 employees. QED itself was founded in Mayfield Village in 2006 by Hiroyuki Fujita, who kept the remaining 30%.

Privately held window and door maker founded 1925 in Pella, Iowa, with about 7,000 employees (2019) to 10,000 nationwide; its own Form 5500 plan shows 8,521 participants in 2019 and 11,593 in 2023, consistent with 5000+. The grant supported a new Troy, Ohio manufacturing plant.

Amazon.com Services LLC is the operating subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. (Seattle), which reported about 1,541,000 full- and part-time employees at Dec 31, 2022 in its 10-K. The Form 5500 plan under this EIN had 1,295,394 participants in 2023.

parent: Hyland Software, Inc. (majority owned by Thoma Bravo)
notes: Founded 1991 and headquartered in Westlake; private equity firm Thoma Bravo has been majority owner since 2007. Form 5500 participants were 3,242 in 2019 and Top Workplaces lists about 3,500 US employees, so the company was under 5,000 in the 2018-2020 grant years (it reached roughly 5,000 by 2023, when it cut 1,000 jobs).

Public company headquartered in Abbott Park, Illinois; its FY2023 10-K reports approximately 114,000 employees, 69% outside the U.S. The Ohio grants relate to the Columbus nutrition plant (428 retained jobs per JobsOhio metrics).

parent: Sofidel S.p.A. (Sofidel Group; Stefani and Lazzareschi families)
notes: Sofidel America Corp. is the U.S. arm of the family-owned Sofidel Group of Porcari, Italy, which had more than 6,400 employees around 2019 (6,900 by 2023); the Circleville tissue plant opened Oct 2018 as the group's largest. The U.S. entity's own Form 5500 plan grew from 347 participants (2015) to 1,244 (2019).

AMG Vanadium LLC (Cambridge, OH, about 155 employees) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Amsterdam-listed AMG Advanced Metallurgical Group N.V., whose 2020 annual report states approximately 3,000 employees worldwide. The grant supported the $300M second plant in Zanesville.

Port authority created under Ohio Revised Code Chapter 4582 with board members appointed by the Mahoning and Trumbull county commissioners; it owns the Youngstown-Warren Regional Airport and received OSIP spec-building and aerospace grants. A political subdivision with a small staff; no employee count published.

Public biotech headquartered in Cambridge, MA (FY2022 10-K); 10-K-derived headcounts were 840 (2021), 1,162 (2022) and 1,314 (2023), with 575 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 1,415 in 2023. The grants supported its Columbus gene therapy facilities (138 retained jobs).

County port authority, a political subdivision organized under Ohio Revised Code Chapter 4582, used as the public vehicle for JobsOhio site grants in Athens County. No project release or staffing figure was found online (searched OhioSE, JobsOhio and Athens news sites); a small-staff public body regardless.

CareSource Management Services LLC is the management subsidiary of CareSource, a Dayton nonprofit Medicaid/Medicare health plan founded in 1989 with about 4,500 employees and $11.8B revenue in 2020 (Form 5500 sponsor CareSource Management Group had 4,622 participants in 2019). Classed nonprofit rather than hospital because it is an insurer, not a health system.

NYSE-listed B&W moved its headquarters from Charlotte to Akron on Dec 30, 2019 (the Charlotte address in the 990 is the old one), and its FY2020 10-K reports approximately 2,100 employees worldwide. Form 5500 participants (7,259 in 2019) run far above headcount because they include retirees and former employees of the much larger pre-2015 company.

Private automotive roof-rack maker headquartered in Saline, Michigan (technical center in Pontiac) with about 1,500 North American employees in 2015 and 1,910 Form 5500 participants in 2019; the Ohio project is a Napoleon, OH plant. Ownership has been reported as venture/private capital in the past, but no current owner filing was found.

Family-owned lift truck maker founded 1945 in New Bremen, Ohio, with about 20,900 employees worldwide today and 11,737 Form 5500 participants in 2019; JobsOhio counts 4,348 retained Ohio jobs. Fourth generation of the Dicke family still leads it.

parent: Xellia Pharmaceuticals ApS (wholly owned by Novo Holdings A/S)
notes: Copenhagen-based anti-infectives maker with over 1,800 employees globally (2021) and more than 300 at the Bedford, Ohio plant it bought from Boehringer Ingelheim in 2015; wholly owned since 2013 by Novo Holdings A/S, the Novo Nordisk Foundation's investment arm. Form 5500 participants at the U.S. entity were 419 in 2019.

parent: Caldwell Mobile Home Sales, Inc. / Crock Construction (family-owned)
notes: Landowner and developer of the Caldwell East of I-77 Business Park in Noble County, funded with over $2.4M in JobsOhio-Ohio Southeast Site Initiative grants (April 2022 release), described as a third-generation family-owned local construction and manufactured-home retail company. No employee count, Form 5500 or directory listing was found; a rural family retailer with no pension filing is almost certainly under 100.

parent: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. (via Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing; CAM was Tinicum-owned until Feb 2020)
notes: Voss was bought from its ESOP in Sept 2014 by Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing (CAM), a Tinicum private equity portfolio company, which Stanley Black & Decker (New Britain, CT; about 53,100 employees) acquired for $1.46B on Feb 24, 2020, inside the FY2020 grant year. During the FY2019 grant the owner was PE-backed CAM, whose group headcount was not published; Voss alone had 170-291 Form 5500 participants.
